name: Neck Skin Consistency
description: Analyzes neck skin 文本ure consistency
algorithm: Neck Skin Consistency — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes neck skin characteristics for deepfake detection:

1. **Neck区域Segmentation**: The neck region is segmented — the area between the jawline and collar/clothing line. This region is forensically important as it lies at the boundary or outside the typical face-swap region.

2. **人脸-Neck皮肤匹配**: Skin characteristics (color, tone, texture, sun damage, aging) should be consistent between face and neck. The method compares skin properties across the face-neck boundary. Face-swap deepfakes may show mismatched skin between the generated face and original neck — different color temperature, different texture quality, or different aging characteristics.

3. **Neck皮肤纹理分析**: Neck skin has characteristic texture: horizontal creases (neck lines), visible platysma muscle bands in some individuals, and different pore distribution than facial skin. The method evaluates whether neck texture is consistent with the face age and quality. AI-generated faces may show an unnatural transition at the jaw-neck boundary.

4. **颜色ContinuityAcross下巴**: The color transition from face to neck should be smooth and physically motivated (slightly different sun exposure). The method measures color discontinuity at the jawline. Deepfake blending often creates subtle but detectable color seams at this boundary.

5. **时间Neck-人脸相干性**: Neck skin should respond to head motion consistently — rotating head reveals different neck surfaces, creates characteristic skin folds, and shows consistent skin tone from different angles. The method tracks neck-face coherence across frames. Deepfake face movement that doesn't correctly account for neck kinematics produces detectable inconsistencies.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through neck skin consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
